title.narrative: Education for All Fast Track Initiative Secretariat Multi Donor Trust Fund

description.narrative: To finance the work program of the FTI Secretariat. The activities of the Secretariat include: (a) manage the Secretariat, including staff recruitment, budgeting and work programming, (b) manage the Catalytic Fund, (c) develop and manage a Facility for Program Preparation, (d) prepare and organize Partnership meetings, (e) develop and implement a communications and outreach strategy, (f) support the Partnership working groups, (g) monitor country progress in achieving EFA, aid flows and financing gaps, (h) respond to requests for briefings and information.
